These manifests are copied unchanged from the Gateway API conformance suite,
module sigs.k8s.io/gateway-api/conformance v1.7.0 (released 2026-10-29):
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/tree/v1.7.0/conformance

- base-manifests.yaml  <- conformance/base/manifests.yaml
- *.yaml               <- conformance/tests/*.yaml

Copyright The Kubernetes Authors. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(the same licence as ReverseDock; see LICENSE at the repository root).

They are test input for the API types in src/api: every Gateway API document of a
kind we model must deserialise. They contain no key material (TLS Secrets are
created by the suite at run time).
